<!--
  The simple pull quote (model pull-quote@1): the words in a blockquote, then the author (names the section), a
  role line and the source as a link, in a figure. Axes: layout (rule: a bar in the primary token at the start,
  centered: centred, no bar).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type PullQuoteSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    quote: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    sourceLabel?: string;
    sourceHref?: string;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    layout?: "rule" | "centered";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    quote,
    title,
    description = "",
    sourceLabel = "",
    sourceHref = "",
    padding = "standard",
    layout = "rule",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: PullQuoteSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const frame = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "rule" ? "flex flex-row gap-6"
    : "flex flex-col items-center"
  );
  const copyAlign = $derived(((layout as string) === "rule") ? "start" : "center");
  const copyText = $derived(((layout as string) === "rule") ? "text-start" : "text-center");
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="pull-quote-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Box tag="figure" class={cn("mx-auto max-w-3xl", frame)}>
      {#if ((layout as string) === "rule")}
        <Box class="w-2 shrink-0 self-stretch rounded-full bg-primary" aria-hidden="true" />
      {/if}
      <Stack gap="6" align={copyAlign}>
        <Text tag="blockquote" size="2xl" weight="medium" class={cn("tracking-tight", copyText)}>
          {quote}
        </Text>
        <Stack gap="2" align={copyAlign}>
          <Text size="base" weight="semibold" class={copyText} id={titleId}>
            {title}
          </Text>
          {#if description}
            <Text size="sm" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", copyText)}>
              {description}
            </Text>
          {/if}
          {#if (sourceLabel && sourceHref)}
            <LinkPlain href={urlOf(sourceHref)} class="text-primary hover:text-foreground">
              <Text size="sm">
                {sourceLabel}
              </Text>
            </LinkPlain>
          {/if}
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </Container>
</Block>
